structural_change: HBMA-LKEP 10-17 successor of lkep_face_ref-face2dir-ce9d51d9f (CLOSED TT +299.83 / FF +26.31 but NATIVE FAIL: capture 204.7 > 190 on 21 inputs = session f_lk_rx[570:547] + fault + locked; launch 218.3 core_session[21]). Cause: session and {fault,locked} crossed the tile through ONE register, so io_flop_at_pins could anchor it at only one pin and the crossing wire sat on both pins. Fix: flop-first both ways -- session gets an input pin register (f_lk side) and a separate output pin register (core side); {fault,locked} get an input pin register (core side) and a separate output pin register (f_lk side). +1 edge on session (pin->core) and +1 edge on {fault,locked} (core->pin); no other path changes. Faces follow the d4f run6 placement (top-down): the core host_cp_ep sits EAST of host_cp_ep_face (x 20655.0 vs face 20595.6..20653.9) and landing/packet/phy WEST/NW, so core buses move W->E and f_lk_rx/f_lk_tx E->W (the closed view had them mirrored). Outline unchanged = die slot 58.32 x 116.64.
